== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Elder]] Empire is a civilization established following the era of the [[Great Elders]], who previously ruled the world and held humanity in slavery. While the [[Elders]] are described as eternal beings with immense power over life, death, knowledge, and time, they were eventually overthrown during the [[Elder War]]. The current Empire was founded by the Emperor, who maintained stability by borrowing power from these entities to rule as a figure above ordinary men. This long-standing rule has faced significant challenges, particularly following the death of the Emperor, which led to political instability among the various [[Guilds]] and increased activity from the [[Elders]]. The [[Great Elders]] are viewed with a mixture of fear and curiosity. Some believe they are malevolent forces seeking to destroy civilization and reclaim their former dominion, while others suggest they possess vast wisdom that could benefit humanity if a working relationship is established. These entities operate according to specific purposes—such as the pursuit of knowledge, change, or annihilation—and often use containers to exert their influence. They are believed to be currently sleeping, though many fear they are awakening to break free from their perceived prison. [[The Empire]]'s defense involves various groups, including the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Luminian Order]], who work to contain Elder threats, research their biology, and prevent them from corrupting human leadership.}}
